subject.title: feat: open Control UI links in a macOS sidebar browser

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor the macOS in-app sidebar browser for external Control UI HTTP(S) links now that the dormant web bridge has landed?
rationale: This adds a new native external-content surface inside the macOS app, and the protected `maintainer` plus product-decision labels mean automation should not choose the direction.

options.title: Build the scoped macOS sidebar
options.body: Proceed with the second PR: register the WebKit bridge in the macOS dashboard and add the controlled WKWebView split pane with proof.

options.title: Keep default-browser behavior
options.body: Decline the in-app browser direction and leave external links opening in the user's system browser.

options.title: Request a security/design spike
options.body: Ask for a smaller prototype or security note before approving arbitrary external pages inside the app.

recommendation.title: Build the scoped macOS sidebar
recommendation.body: Proceed with the second PR: register the WebKit bridge in the macOS dashboard and add the controlled WKWebView split pane with proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He opened the product request and authored the merged first-step bridge that the remaining macOS work would consume.
